INITIAL_EXPLORATION.name: INITIAL_EXPLORATION
INITIAL_EXPLORATION.objective: Place individual objects to observe baseline detector responses.
guidelines: Test each object (A, B, C) individually
Record which objects alone activate the detector
Clear the detector between tests for clean observations

COMBINATION_TESTING.name: COMBINATION_TESTING
COMBINATION_TESTING.objective: Test object combinations to identify interaction effects.
guidelines: Compare combined results to individual results
Note which combinations change the detector state

transitions.condition: If results are confusing, go back to singles

HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.name: HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION
HYPOTHESIS_EVALUATION.objective: Evaluate evidence to determine rule type and blickets.
guidelines: Consider: does each blicket alone activate? (disjunctive)
Consider: are all blickets needed together? (conjunctive)
List evidence for and against each hypothesis

transitions.condition: When you have a clear hypothesis
If hypothesis is unclear, test more combinations

VERIFICATION.name: VERIFICATION
VERIFICATION.objective: Run confirming tests and submit your answer.
guidelines: Design a test that would distinguish your hypothesis from alternatives
If disconfirmed, return to hypothesis evaluation
